translations.web: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
translations.bsb: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
translations.kjv: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
translations.asv: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;
